newsitem.title: USA: ITI Technologies buys product line.
newsitem.headline: ITI Technologies buys product line.

text.p: ITI Technologies Inc said Tuesday its subsidiary, Interactive Technologies Inc, has acquired a product line and dealer program from the Silent Knight division of Willknight Inc of Maple Grove, Minn.
The Regency product line acquired from Willknight offers intrusion protection, fire protection and access control.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
ITI Technologies is the parent of both ITI, a manufacturer of wireless electronic security systems, and CADDX Controls Inc, a manufacturer of advanced hardwired security systems.

"Today's announcement will expand our position as a leading provider of security products and marketing programs to the electronic alarm industry," said Thomas Auth, chairman of ITI Technologies, in a statement.
